record.title: Reconcile the explicit ADB evidence profile before further tooling
record.intent: Select any necessary protocol follow-up from evidence instead of weakening checks for progress.
requirements: Independently review framing and reply matching, verify strict checks installed distributions and remote CI, and commit and push conclusions.
If retained traffic does not fit the checksum-required profile, record the exact discrepancy and admit any other profile separately after reference reconciliation.
Recheck the autonomous deadline and identify a useful bounded offline successor or final checkpoint.
acceptance: The implemented evidence claim is supported and any unsupported profile remains explicit.
